generatedProse.practice-connection:
From here, citation is part of almost every piece of work you submit. Each essay, report and longer project asks you to bring in sources, reference them accurately, and keep to one style throughout. Done well, it protects your academic integrity and earns marks against the criteria. The habit to keep is simple: cite as you write, build each reference from its pattern, and apply one style across the whole list.

That same habit of sourcing a claim carefully carries into research and professional practice, where trust depends on it. Wherever your work rests on other people's, showing where each idea came from is what lets others rely on what you have done.
